description: servicios.idee.es: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Official INSPIRE Data and Services Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by servicios.idee.es. Coverage: the area served by servicios.idee.es. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Peligrosidad por inundación fluvial T=100; Peligrosidad por inundación fluvial T=500; Peligrosidad por inundación fluvial T=10; Servicio WMS (Web Map Service) Peligrosidad por Inundación. Formats seen: WMS, WMTS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-codsi.
